answer: Behavioral Divergence Audit. Each agent must answer a fresh challenge drawn from live network conditions, and the response is logged as a gale of timestamped decisions. A clone can copy the answer but cannot reproduce the divergent path that produced it, so identical reply histories expose the whole thread as one operator. Enforcement scores path entropy across sessions; sharing fails once histories converge. Attacker cost: one distinct interaction record and separate chained state per identity, growing like split timber with every added clone.
